in_marathi.name: Ashirya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Gift of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashirya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ashirya is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Ashta’ which means eight and ‘Riya’ which means joy. This name is bestowed upon a child as a symbol of the eighth joy that the parents experience upon the arrival of their child. In Hindu mythology, Ashirya is also associated with the Goddess of knowledge, Saraswati, who is believed to bestow wisdom and knowledge upon her devotees.
